summary: Customs duty liability upon redemption of confiscated goods; analysis of Sections 11-12/28/125/125AB of Customs Act; distinction between confiscation proceedings and duty assessment; Jagdish Cancer case ratio clarified; departmental liability for duty persists despite redemption post-fine payment; interest under Section 28AB applies when Section 28 assessment triggers; duty liability under Section 125(2) must be assessed under Section 28; High Court correct in distinguishing precedent; remanded for interest calculation.
final_judgment: High Court upheld; matter remanded to Settlement Commission to compute and recover interest under Section 28AB.
